_comment: ACT Math blueprint — CURRENT spec (2025+): 45 questions, 50 minutes, 4 answer choices. Categories per official ACT reporting categories. Content = Fable-authored, verified items (seeds/act-fable-items.generated.json). Replaces the legacy 60-question/5-choice blueprint.
title: ACT Math Practice Test
subject: act-math
_categoryWeightsComment: Slots per 45-item form, set to the official ACT reporting-category shares: Integrating Essential Skills 40-43% (19/45 = 42.2%) and Preparing for Higher Math 57-60% (26/45 = 57.8%), with N&Q 7-10%, Algebra 12-15%, Functions 12-15%, Geometry 12-15%, Stats & Prob 8-12%. IES was previously 9 (20%) ONLY because the item bank held 105 IES items; seeds/act-ies-expansion added 300 more, so the authentic weight is now supportable at ~21 non-repeating forms. Do not raise a weight past what the bank can fill -- assembleForm reports unfillable slots as gaps.
_difficultyRampComment: Target difficulty by position: ANCHORS, interpolated piecewise-linearly between them (utils/actTestAssembler.difficultyForPosition). Real ACT Math is ordered by ascending difficulty -- approximately, and as a smooth curve, which the three flat plateaus this replaced (15@2 / 15@3 / 15@4) could not express: a student met a full difficulty step between Q15 and Q16 and then nothing for fifteen questions. Two properties are deliberate. (1) The TAIL is steeper than the body. On a real form the last ~5 items are markedly harder than items 31-40 -- that is where students run out of clock -- so a flat 4 through Q45 understated the baseline for exactly the strong students the bootcamp most needs to target precisely. (2) The MEAN target is 3.02 against the old ramp's 3.00, held equal on purpose: scaledScore.scaledByRaw below is calibrated to a form of this average difficulty. Reshape the curve freely, but if you move the mean, re-derive that table too or every practice score shifts. ACT-Math-only: English/Reading/Science are ordered by passage and question-to-line reference, NOT difficulty, so do not copy this ramp into another section's blueprint.

scaledScore._comment: APPROXIMATE raw(0-45)->scaled(1-36) estimate for practice feedback only.
